name: Letterboxd import
author: Lichtspiel
description: Each person uploads their Letterboxd export (a ZIP from letterboxd.com → Settings → Import & Export) in their panel under Settings and brings in what they watched (with the diary's dates), their ratings, their watchlist and their lists — onto their watchlist or as playlists. Films are found by their TMDB or IMDb id, looked up once on Letterboxd.
